ops.fn: () => { const R=(n)=>{const r=n.getBoundingClientRect(); const s=getComputedStyle(n); return {x:Math.round(r.left),y:Math.round(r.top),w:Math.round(r.width),h:Math.round(r.height),disp:s.display,pos:s.position,op:s.opacity,z:s.zIndex,vis:s.visibility,bg:s.backgroundColor.slice(0,24)}}; const h=document.querySelector('.oprn-status-menu .status-menu-header'); const out={menu:document.querySelector('.oprn-status-menu')?.dataset, header:h?R(h):null}; for (const c of ['gold','time','chapter','location']) { const n=document.querySelector('.status-menu-'+c); out[c]=n?R(n):null; } out.dock=R(document.querySelector('.status-menu-primary-dock')); return out; }
